Fur Capelet & Snowy Forest
Rights check
Source: 24404.jpg
Wintry, romantic, storybook
WORKING NOTES
- The fur capelet and ribbon tie are the signature details.
- Keep the snowy trees for a storybook backdrop.
Try this: Keep the snowy trees for a storybook backdrop.
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, fair
hair under a deep fur-lined hood looks
up and to the side. She wears a fur
capelet with a brown ribbon tie at the
throat over a cream wool coat. Tall
snow-covered evergreens rise behind
her. Her expression is calm and dreamy.
Soft, diffused winter light. Palette of
cream, taupe, and snowy white. Wintry
and romantic, in the style of a fairytale
winter editorial.
